Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1016
Claimant:
William Stone
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
August 26, 2023
First notice of loss received for a low-speed head-on collision involving the insured's vehicle. The claimant reports
neck pain and is represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their office.
October 11, 2023
Verified that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the loss date. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the coverage period.
October 20, 2023
Police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. Two other parties involved in the collision
also place the clamiant in the vehicle.
December 14, 2023
Scene photographs were revieewd and confirm several details of the impact. No independent witnesses have come
forward to describe how the collision occurred.
December 21, 2023
Recorded statement taken from the claimant through counsel. The account of how the collision happened matches
what was given at first notice and in the earlier phone contact.
January 8, 2024
Medical records reviewed. The reported whiplash injury is consistent with the type and force of this crash. No prior
injury to the same area of the body is known.
February 4, 2024
Treatment followed a typical course of care and tapered as the claimant improved. Records show steady progress
with no unusual gaps or escalations.
February 21, 2024
Repair estimate and inspection reviewed. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, but it is not yet clear whether all
listed damage resulted from this impact, so a second review has been requested.
February 28, 2024
File is pending the second damage review and receipt of the final treatment summary. Reserve remains open and the
calim will be reassessed once both items are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
